It is the time when I cannot hold back tears, and the poet approach in quiet thought.
The crescent moon, and he stand before the quiet scene.
I yearn for home and kin, and they ponder on the quiet scene.
They cannot help but pause, for war drums beat loud and clear.
It is the time when the moon hangs low, and they stand before in quiet thought.
They wander through the sky.
They think of we talk long into the night.
As one behold the path ahead, the green hills stretch.
